items.rationale: At the recorded 1,280 x 720 desktop-js profile, the paragraph has opaque foreground rgb(255, 253, 248) and its nearest painted ancestor is the opaque status-card background rgb(50, 16, 47). The target and card have no background image, opacity reduction, filter, blend mode or text shadow that could reduce contrast. Their WCAG sRGB relative-luminance contrast ratio is 16.5157:1 (16.52:1), above the 4.5:1 AA threshold applicable to this 16 px, weight-400 text. The axe incomplete therefore does not disclose a contrast failure or a runner blocker.
items.method: Served the exact Build 14 bundle locally and reproduced route / in the pinned Chromium 151.0.7922.34 runtime at 1,280 x 720. Inspected the target and ancestor chain with getComputedStyle() and getBoundingClientRect(), cross-checked exact index.html SHA-256 6d6f02be8ee5638a1c6b629f688598ab65e26fede988f78978a4edc9e51a7ecd and styles.css SHA-256 891e4e7f3558f94c4eeca7a9a3a47357370aa60cb756909faca830a533cf8a3f, then calculated WCAG relative luminance and (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) from the computed colours.

items.rationale: At the recorded 320 x 800 mobile-js profile, the heading has opaque foreground rgb(24, 20, 26), size 51.2 px and weight 500 over body paper rgb(247, 244, 236), giving 16.5592:1 (16.56:1). Its box intersects the decorative parcel group, whose 2 px borders are rgb(50, 16, 47), but opacity 0.14 is applied once to the whole group. Conservatively treating every pixel behind the heading as a fully painted parcel pixel gives composite rgb(219.42, 212.08, 209.54) and 12.4600:1 (12.46:1). That remains above 4.5:1 without relying on the less stringent large-text threshold. The axe incomplete therefore does not disclose a contrast failure or a runner blocker.
